artworks.title: Fantasy of Perspectival Forms Set among Ruins
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of Mrs. Daryl Reich Rubenstein
artworks.description: The image shows a complex arrangement of geometric shapes and lines, including circular forms, angular structures, and intersecting linear elements. This abstract artwork has elements reminiscent of architectural ruins, with towers, arches, and columns merging into a surreal cityscape. The foreground features spiral and cylindrical shapes resembling scrolls or rolled-up paper, while the background includes archways and architectural motifs resembling fragments of an ancient city. The interplay of familiar objects challenges the viewer's perception of space and form.

artworks.title: An Ancient Tree with Figures in a Landscape
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an old tree in the center, another tree in the distance, and a soft horizon line. The tree is detailed with pencil strokes for the bark and foliage, in grayscale tones. The background is blurry, highlighting the main tree in the foreground.

artworks.title: A Bird
artworks.medium: wood engraving on China paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird perched on a branch. The bird is shown in profile, emphasizing its beak and body. The bird is depicted with fine lines detailing its feathers and features, while the perch is textured to resemble aged bark. The artwork has a style reminiscent of traditional woodcut illustrations, with a focus on texture and form against a plain background.

artworks.title: The Old Man and His Sons
artworks.medium: wood engraving on China paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a group of figures engaged in an outdoor activity. The figures are working together on a task involving wood or rope. They are depicted in an oval frame with detailed line work for texture and shading. The background shows vegetation and trees, indicating an outdoor setting. One figure is seated while the others are in motion. A structure with a window is also included in the background. The drawing uses intricate lines and cross-hatching for depth and detail, similar to traditional etching or engraving techniques.

artworks.title: The Waterfalls at Tivoli
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache and gum arabic and touches of pen and ink over graphite, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a vast valley, hills, a sky with clouds, two people in red clothing seated with sheep, greenery, waterfalls, classical structures, and lush trees. The composition is characterized by detailed brushstrokes, creating a serene atmosphere with earthy tones.

artworks.title: Larici from the Convent of the Galoro
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite touched with gum arabic on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a town in the center-right. The horizon appears high on the left with land meeting water. The sky contains gentle cumulus clouds. Fine brushstrokes detail the architecture and natural scenery. Foliage is depicted close by, leading to the town with domes and towers. The color palette includes blues, grays, and muted earth tones, suggesting early morning or late afternoon light.

artworks.title: Seated Peasant Woman with Sleeping Child
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman seated with a child on her back. The woman is wearing a long dress and a hat, and she carries a jug. The child is dressed similarly to the woman and appears secure. In the foreground, there is a carved stone with inscriptions and foliage. The background is a detailed sky.

artworks.title: Peasant Boy Asleep near Two Sheep
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two sheep in a peaceful outdoor setting. One sheep is sitting upright while the other is laying down near a tree. There are foliage and a tree trunk in the background. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading, using subtle colors to depict the sheep and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Goat and Two Kids
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three goats. The largest goat is standing facing the viewer, with a coat featuring a mix of darker hues with highlights of white and faint orange. Its fur texture is achieved using fine lines and shading. Beside it, two smaller goats are reclining on the ground; one is nestled next to the other, who gazes toward the standing goat. In the backdrop, a tree with textured bark and minimal foliage creates a rustic atmosphere. The technique involves intricate linework, typical of pen and ink drawings, capturing the natural dynamics of the scene.

artworks.title: Two Reclining Sheep and One Standing Sheep
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three sheep. The drawing shows three sheep, two lying down and one standing. Fine lines and a palette of soft grays and oranges depict the texture of the sheep’s wool. The background is minimal, highlighting the sheep. The use of black lines against the colored paper adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Seated Peasant Boy Holding a Sheep
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy sitting cross-legged on the ground with one arm around a sheep. The boy wears a dark hat, a light-colored shirt, and his feet are bare. The sheep has thick, fluffy fur. The background is a plain outdoor setting with a small patch of plants or grass.

artworks.title: Three Goats
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 17.5 x 14 cm (6 7/8 x 5 1/2 in.)
overall: 28 x 22.1 cm (11 x 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three goats in a natural setting. The drawing depicts three goats with curved horns. One goat is standing in the center, reaching up towards a cluster of branches with leaves. Another goat is to the left, focused elsewhere, and a third is resting on the ground in the foreground. The foliage is detailed, creating a realistic scene. The artwork is monochromatic with detailed line work against a colored background. The artist's signature and date are in the upper right corner. The composition balances the forms of the goats with their surroundings.

artworks.title: Child Shepherdess with Flock
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a child standing in a full-length position, facing slightly left and looking at the viewer. The child is wearing a cloak with a hood covering most of their head. They are dressed in a long garment and hold a wooden staff with one hand. In the background, sheep are grazing on the ground, with foliage and a tree trunk visible, suggesting a pastoral outdoor scene. The sky is not visible, keeping the focus on the child, the sheep, and the environment.

artworks.title: Reclining Cow and Calf in the Open
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cows in a pastoral setting. The drawing features two cows, one standing and one lying down, set against a backdrop of foliage and a couple of sheep in the distance. The image is detailed with fine line work to depict the texture of the cows' fur and the surrounding natural environment. The animals are given attention with cross-hatching techniques, creating depth and texture, and their expressions are rendered with soft, naturalistic detail. The serene setting suggests a calm pastoral scene, emphasizing the harmony between the animals and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Woman Spinner and a Shepherd with Flock
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of farm animals and figures in a rustic setting. The scene shows two sheep reclining on the ground alongside a goat in the foreground. One sheep is lying close to a figure crouching near it. Behind, another figure is standing, holding an object resembling a spindle or distaff. The background consists of trees and foliage. The drawing is detailed, illustrating textures such as the wool of the sheep and folds of the figures' clothing.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherdess, a Ram, a Sheep and a Goat
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a resting ram and a standing goat in a rustic landscape. The drawing depicts a scene with a rocky terrain, featuring the animals in detailed form with textured fur. The background includes countryside elements like plants and a distant structure. The use of hatching and cross-hatching technique enhances shading and texture in the image.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Donkey, Sheep and Goat
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a young man from behind, holding a stick and looking at a group of animals. The scene includes a donkey with a bundle, sheep, and goats near a rocky outcrop. The background has a cloudy sky transitioning from land. The artwork is detailed with fine lines resembling traditional etching. The color scheme includes grays and blacks with hints of light orange on specific elements.

artworks.title: Horse, Ram, Goat with Kid; In the Distance a Shepherd with Flock
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of farm animals in a pastoral scene. The drawing depicts a group of farm animals, including a horse, goats, and a ram, resting in a grassy area. In the background, there is a figure sitting on a rock. The scene is rich with detail, emphasizing the texture of the animals' fur and the surrounding foliage. The composition is calm and serene, capturing a moment of rest in a rural setting.

artworks.title: Sleeping Old Man with Dog
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person slumped in a reclined position on the left side with their left arm resting on a draped piece of cloth. They have grey hair and a beard and wear a cap, long-sleeved coat, waistcoat, knee-length trousers, and bear feet. They hold a walking stick in their left hand. A dog lies in front of them with its head on its paws. The background consists of trees and foliage, with a jug and bowl on the cloth-draped table beside the person.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Walking Stick and a Peasant Woman with Child
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in the foreground holding a stick. He is wearing a long garment and sandals. Next to him is a goat. In the background, there is a woman holding an infant, and another person partially visible. The setting appears to be outdoors, with vegetation and a landscape visible.

artworks.title: Shepherd Pointing Out the Direction to a Shepherdess
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of farm animals in a pastoral scene. The drawing shows a cow, sheep, and a goat on a path or area. The cow is in the center with other animals around. There is a tree with sparse foliage on the right side, grassy details in the foreground and near the animals.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherdess
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman wearing a long dress with patches of color, sitting with her back partially turned next to a goat. In the background, a flock of sheep are gathered in a field with trees on the left and a wooden fence. The color scheme is mostly gray with occasional warm orange accents. The scene is depicted with detailed lines and shading, creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherdess with Three Rams
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three sheep in a pastoral setting. The sheep have textured wool and are surrounded by leafy foliage. In the background, there are hints of vegetation. The style is delicate with intricate details. The setting suggests a peaceful atmosphere. The hatching and shading techniques emphasize texture and depth, enhancing the lifelike appearance of the sheep and vegetation.

artworks.title: Donkey with her Foal, a Dog, and a Peasant Man
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring animals and a figure. The composition shows two donkeys standing on rocky terrain with a small dog lying down in the foreground. To the left is a figure dressed in simple clothing, holding a stick and interacting with the donkeys. The donkeys are detailed, and the dog appears relaxed. The drawing captures a serene and pastoral moment, highlighting the texture of the animals' coats and the natural environment. The background suggests a wide open landscape, enhancing the sense of space and tranquility.
